searchText: zk-snark to prove you can create the block and weren't slashed in the past? but how to detect the surround slash condition I think you could have the act of validating be correlated, meaning you can identify each validator uniquely. What I would like to see is no link between the depositor, the withdrawer, and the validator. ohh, that one is simple you could make each deposit a tornado cash thing right well, at least for deposits You deposit, which gives you some kind of nullifiable proof of deposit, and when you withdraw you simply prove you have withdrawable assets, without linking to validator or depositor. the problem with withdrawals is that amounts are different. it's much harder to make them anon well, disconnected from the validator actually, I think tornado devs were working on something like that for arbitrary amounts. tornado nova? but it never got released because they were sanctioned but it would need to be used by others too, allow internal transfers, so would need to become a wide ethereum thing, not just for validators but making deposits anon is relatively trivial, could just reuse known to be safe tornado code and keys. would be great if that became the only way to create new validators Even just anonymizing deposits (unlikable to validators/withdrawals) would be a big privacy win I think. Better would be full anonymity between all 3, but simplicity may win out if it means actually getting implemented without too much debate. well can't really support you directly, but would be happy to see such an eip (put proven tornado code and keys in front of deposits) implemented
